scope: Physical PDF classic/hybrid, raw/Flate/TIFF/PNG/RunLength/ASCII xrefs, raw/Flate/TIFF/PNG/RunLength/ASCII and filter pipeline ObjStm ranges and effective xref selection; no ownership/body resolution

tests.command: pytest tests/native/test_pdf_filter_pipeline.py tests/native/test_pdf_ascii.py tests/native/test_pdf_runlength.py tests/native/test_pdf_tiff_predictor.py tests/native/test_pdf_predictors.py tests/native/test_pdf_xref_streams.py tests/native/test_pdf_revisions.py tests/native/test_pdf_object_streams.py tests/native/test_pdf_xref_state.py tests/test_anatomy.py -q

independent_reader: pypdf: page count, compressed metadata, object offsets and object-stream/index agree

fixture.producer: Own byte-level fixture, not a Formats or PDF writer

limits: read-only inspection and unchanged source bytes
shared xref/ObjStm item, token and byte budgets
unchanged CLI destination on late member syntax error
selected xref records share max_items with physical records and ObjStm members
every intermediate filter output charged to total work quota
aligned DecodeParms and whole-plan validation before decoding
not_proven: encrypted/indirect or other unsupported ObjStm profiles
independent_prediction: pypdf checks all declared PNG predictors on full PDFs; Pillow checks all five row algorithms on packed 1/2/4-bit, 8/16-bit and RGB/RGBA PNGs

object_stream_fixture.producer: Own byte-level source, not a Formats writer
object_stream_fixture.external_checks: pypdf: page, metadata, integer, array and null; independent MuPDF-produced original: all container/index pairs checked by pypdf

xref_state_fixture.producer: Own byte-level hybrid source; hidden metadata independently resolved by pypdf
independent_checks: pypdf: generation reuse and free tombstone
pypdf: hybrid metadata before older free entry
MuPDF: current table before conflicting hybrid entry
structural_checks: future type shadows old body as null
